'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Syrian conflict (2024–present)|Syrian conflict]]
**[[SDF–Syrian transitional government clashes (2025–present)|SDF–Syrian transitional government clashes]]
***[[2026 northeastern Syria offensive]]
****Tribal forces allied with the [[Syrian Army]] take control of the Mashlab neighbourhood in [[Raqqa]] from the [[Kurds in Syria|Kurdish]]-led [[Syrian Democratic Forces]] (SDF). [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2026/1/18/syria-fighting-live-sdf-braces-for-raqqa-assault-as-govt-troops-march-on?update=4249009 (Al Jazeera)]
****[[Syrian Armed Forces|Syrian government forces]] seize control of the [[Al-Omar field]] in [[Deir ez-Zor Governorate]], the largest [[Petroleum reservoir|oil field]] in [[Syria]], following the withdrawal of SDF forces. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cx20n55yxrlo (BBC News)]
**The [[Syrian transitional government|Syrian government]] announces a ceasefire with the [[Syrian Democratic Forces]]. [https://apnews.com/article/syria-sdf-kurds-tabaqa-hts-clashes-raqqa-3014df2335a2fa9cb8ba160555ef2bb5 (AP)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c4gwk37ewvwo (BBC News)]
*[[Communal conflicts in Nigeria]]
**[[Boko Haram insurgency]]
***The [[Nigerian Air Force]] launches [[airstrike]]s against [[Boko Haram]] in [[Borno State]], [[Nigeria]], reportedly killing at least 40 militants. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/nigerian-airstrikes-kill-scores-militants-borno-military-says-2026-01-19/ (Reuters)]
**[[Kidnapping in Nigeria]]
***Gunmen abduct about 163 [[Christianity in Nigeria|Christian]]s after storming two churches in [[Kaduna State]], Nigeria. [https://insiderpaper.com/armed-gangs-kidnap-more-than-160-christians-from-two-northern-nigerian-churches-clergy/ (AFP via Insider Paper)]
*[[Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Russo-Ukrainian war]]
**[[Dnipro strikes (2022–present)|Dnipro strikes]], [[Kharkiv strikes (2022–present)|Kharkiv strikes]], [[Khmelnytskyi strikes (2022–present)|Khmelnytskyi strikes]], [[Odesa strikes (2022–present)|Odesa strikes]], [[Zaporizhzhia strikes (2022–present)|Zaporizhzhia strikes]]
***At least two people are killed and dozens are injured in [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian]] [[drone warfare|drone strikes]] across [[Ukraine]], including in [[Dnipro]], [[Kharkiv]], [[Khmelnytskyi]], [[Odesa]], [[Sumy]], and [[Zaporizhzhia]]. **Clashes between two factions of the [[FARC dissidents]] in [[El Retorno]], [[Guaviare Department]], [[Colombia]], leave at least 27 insurgents dead. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/clashes-colombia-between-guerrilla-groups-leave-27-dead-sources-say-2026-01-18/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2026 Adamuz train derailments]]
**At least 39 people are killed and 245 more are injured after two [[AVE|high speed trains]] derailed in [[Adamuz]], [[province of Córdoba (Spain)|province of Córdoba]], [[Spain]]. [https://www.telegraph.co.uk/world-news/2026/01/18/10-dead-two-trains-derail-spain/ (''The Telegraph'')]
*[[2026 Binaliw landslide]]
**[[Search and rescue]] operations in the [[Garbage landslide|collapsed]] [[landfill]] in [[Cebu City]], [[Philippines]], conclude after retrieving the last victim, bringing the total number of deaths to 36. [https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/regions/973233/cebu-landfill-landslide-victims-now-all-accounted-for-with-last-missing-body-found/story/ (GMA News)]
*[[2026 Indonesia Air Transport ATR 42 crash]]
**Search and rescue finds the wreckage of an [[Indonesia Air Transport]] [[ATR 42-500|ATR 42-512]] aircraft that crashed in [[Maros Regency]], [[South Sulawesi]], [[Indonesia]]. The crew recovers one body of the eleven passengers from a ravine. [https://apnews.com/article/indonesia-plane-crash-sulawesi-9c0218bfe34a6c16d265be996cfcc12d (AP)]
*Five people are killed and over 80 others are injured after a bus overturned due to brake failure in [[Latehar district]], [[India]]. [https://www.devdiscourse.com/article/science-environment/3774089-tragic-wedding-journey-bus-crash-in-jharkhand-claims-lives (Devdiscourse)]
*Four people are killed, 84 others are injured, and six are reported missing in an explosion at a [[steel mill|steel factory]] in [[Baotou]], [[Inner Mongolia]], [[China]]. [[Law enforcement in China|Chinese police]] detain those in charge of the factory the following day. [https://apnews.com/article/china-inner-mongolia-factory-explosion-baotou-steel-2ea4d95cb5ceac49acd92924133a6a82 (AP)] [https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/article/factory-explosion-in-chinas-inner-mongolia-region-kills-2-and-hospitalizes-66/ (CTV News)]

**[[Guatemala]]n [[President of Guatemala|president]] [[Bernardo Arévalo]] declares a 30-day nationwide [[state of emergency]] after gangs killed eight [[National Civil Police (Guatemala)|police]] officers and took dozens of prison staff hostage, while [[Armed Forces of Guatemala|security forces]] have retaken three prisons and freed the captives. *The [[Philippines]] [[Bureau of Immigration (Philippines)|Bureau of Immigration]] confirms that Russian [[YouTube|YouTuber]] [[Vitaly Zdorovetskiy]], who was previously arrested in the [[Philippines]] last year, has been deported to [[Irkutsk]], [[Russia]]. Additionally, the [[Bureau of Immigration (Philippines)|Bureau of Immigration]] adds his name to the agency [[Blacklisting|blacklist]] from entering the country. '''Politics and elections'''
*[[2026 Portuguese presidential election]]
**[[Portugal|Portuguese]] citizens vote in the first round of the [[President of Portugal|presidential]] election between 11 candidates to succeed incumbent [[Marcelo Rebelo de Sousa]], who has reached his [[term limit]]. [[Socialist Party (Portugal)|Socialist Party]] candidate [[António José Seguro]] and [[CHEGA]] leader [[André Ventura]] advance to the second round. [https://apnews.com/article/portugal-presidential-election-candidates-populist-runoff-9c9976eaff53e70f28050a3556288622 (AP)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2025 Africa Cup of Nations]]
**In [[association football]], [[Senegal national football team|Senegal]] wins its second [[Africa Cup of Nations]] title after defeating hosts [[Morocco national football team|Morocco]] 1–0 after [[extra time]] in the [[2025 Africa Cup of Nations final|2025 final]] in [[Rabat]]. [[Sadio Mané]] is named the tournament's best player. [https://www.reuters.com/sports/soccer/farcical-scenes-cup-nations-final-2026-01-18/ (Reuters)]
*[[2026 Australian Open]]
**In [[tennis]], [[Venus Williams]] becomes the oldest player to participate in the [[2026 Australian Open – Women's singles|women's singles]] draw of an [[Australian Open]] at the age of 45 years and 7 months, surpassing [[Kimiko Date]]'s record from [[2015 Australian Open – Women's singles|2015]]. [https://www.the-independent.com/sport/tennis/australian-open-venus-williams-age-b2902385.html (''The Independent'')]
